# Transit Desk

> An independent MBTA fleet monitoring dashboard built for a frontend technical assessment. Not an official MBTA or Transjakarta service.

## Pages
- [Fleet overview](/): Vehicle positions, multi-select route and trip filters, pagination, and vehicle details.
- [Field guide](/guide): Human-readable explanations, frequently asked questions, and original sources.

## Data provenance
- Vehicle, route, and trip data: https://api-v3.mbta.com
- API documentation: https://api-v3.mbta.com/docs/swagger/index.html
- Map data: OpenStreetMap contributors, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright

## Interpretation
- Geographic coverage: Greater Boston, Massachusetts, USA.
- Dashboard refresh: every 30 seconds while active. Vehicle timestamps come from the source feed and may be older.
- Display timezone: America/New_York (Eastern Time).
- Status values describe position relative to stops, not on-time performance.
- Live vehicle counts and coordinates are transient. Cite the current feed and observation time when discussing them.
